## npm audit [24-30]

**[24]** npm Docs. "Auditing package dependencies for security vulnerabilities."
- URL: https://docs.npmjs.com/auditing-package-dependencies-for-security-vulnerabilities/
- Data extracted: npm audit submits dependency descriptions to the registry and asks for a report of known vulnerabilities. Uses GitHub Advisory Database as source of truth.
- Source quality: PRIMARY.

**[25]** npm Docs. "npm-audit" (CLI v10).
- URL: https://docs.npmjs.com/cli/v10/commands/npm-audit/
- Data extracted: Bulk Advisory endpoint used since npm v7. Generates JSON payload with name and version list, POSTs to registry.
- Source quality: PRIMARY.

**[26]** Dan Abramov. "npm audit: Broken by Design." overreacted.io, July 2021.
- URL: https://overreacted.io/npm-audit-broken-by-design/
- Data extracted: 99%+ false positive rate in context of build tool dependencies. No distinction between dev and prod dependencies. Quote: "npm audit is a stain on the entire npm ecosystem." npm audit fix --force can downgrade to vulnerable versions. Trains developers to ignore real warnings.
- Source quality: PRIMARY (blog by React co-creator). Content confirmed via search summaries and secondary coverage.

**[27]** The Register. "Security warning deluge from npm audit." July 2021.
- URL: https://www.theregister.com/2021/07/09/npm_audit_security/
- Data extracted: Rebecca Turner (Microsoft, npm auditing feature creator) acknowledged revenue considerations shaped design. Report counted transitive dependents rather than unique vulnerable modules.
- Source quality: SECONDARY (tech journalism). Attribution: The Register quoting Rebecca Turner directly.

**[28]** GitHub npm/feedback Discussion #172.
- URL: https://github.com/npm/feedback/discussions/172
- Data extracted: User reported 2-week lag between CVE publication and npm advisory listing. Snyk typically faster.
- Source quality: LOW (community discussion, individual experience).

**[29]** Aikido Blog. "NPM Security Audit: The Missing Layer."
- URL: https://www.aikido.dev/blog/npm-audit-guide
- Data extracted: npm audit only catches known issues, misses zero-days, malware, misconfigurations, abandoned packages. 80% of dependencies remain un-upgraded for over a year. 796 npm packages compromised in Shai-Hulud attack affecting 20M+ weekly downloads.
- Source quality: SECONDARY (vendor blog). Statistics cited without original source attribution.

**[30]** Sonatype. "npm audit."
- URL: https://help.sonatype.com/en/npm-audit.html
- Data extracted: All npm security advisory data migrated to GitHub Advisory Database. Updates pushed to npm database.
- Source quality: SECONDARY (vendor documentation).

## pip-audit [31-36]

**[31]** PyPI. "pip-audit."
- URL: https://pypi.org/project/pip-audit/
- Data extracted: Audits Python environments for packages with known vulnerabilities. Supports osv, pypi, and esms vulnerability services (default is pypi). Supports --osv-url for custom endpoints. Supports PEP 751 lockfiles.
- Source quality: PRIMARY (package registry page).

**[32]** GitHub pypa/pip-audit.
- URL: https://github.com/pypa/pip-audit
- Data extracted: Developed by Trail of Bits with Google support. Licensed Apache 2.0. Supports --fix flag. Resolves dependencies by installing in dedicated environment. CycloneDX JSON/XML output.
- Source quality: PRIMARY (project repository).

**[33]** The Daily Swig (PortSwigger). "Pip-audit: Google-backed tool."
- URL: https://portswigger.net/daily-swig/pip-audit-google-backed-tool-probes-python-environments-for-vulnerable-packages
- Data extracted: Developed by William Woodruff and Alex Cameron of Trail of Bits. Funded by Google. Supported by Dustin Ingram (Google). Quote from project lead: "We wanted to build a tool that didn't have any financial or licensing strings attached."
- Source quality: SECONDARY (tech journalism with direct developer quotes).

**[34]** Six Feet Up. "Safety and pip-audit: Comparing Security Tools."
- URL: https://sixfeetup.com/blog/safety-pip-audit-python-security-tools
- Data extracted: pip-audit provides fix hints for free, Safety requires paid plan. pip-audit doesn't include severity ratings. pip-audit stands as PyPA's official tool. Safety DB licensed CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.
- Source quality: SECONDARY (consultancy blog).

**[35]** GitHub pypa/advisory-database.
- URL: https://github.com/pypa/advisory-database
- Data extracted: PyPA advisory database data exposed by pip-audit. Vulnerabilities integrated into OSV. Existing vulnerabilities collected from NVD CVE feed using heuristics with human triage.
- Source quality: PRIMARY (project repository).

**[36]** Inedo Blog. "pip audit: Strengths and Limits in PyPI Security."
- URL: https://blog.inedo.com/python/pypi-package-vulnerabilities
- Data extracted: pip-audit doesn't include vulnerability severity rating. Can only scan for known PyPI vulnerabilities at build, not in-use packages.
- Source quality: SECONDARY (vendor blog).

## Socket.dev [37-41]

**[37]** Socket.dev. "Socket vs Snyk" comparison page.
- URL: https://socket.dev/compare/socket-vs-snyk
- Data extracted: Socket focuses on behavioral analysis vs CVE-based scanning. Tracks 70+ red flag signals.

**[39]** AppSec Santa. "Socket Review 2026."
- URL: https://appsecsanta.com/socket

- Source quality: SECONDARY (review site). Statistics likely from Socket marketing materials.

**[40]** The Register. "Socket slurps $40M." October 2024.
- URL: https://www.theregister.com/2024/10/22/socket_slurps_40m_to_secure/
- Data extracted: $40M Series B funding round confirmed.
- Source quality: SECONDARY (tech journalism).

**[41]** Socket.dev Pricing page.
- URL: https://socket.dev/pricing
- Data extracted: Free/Individual tier (unlimited devs and repos, 70+ risk types). Team tier (reachability analysis, 60% CVE false positive reduction). Enterprise tier (unlimited scans, SBOM, compliance, SCIM). Per-developer pricing. Dollar amounts not publicly listed.
- Source quality: PRIMARY (vendor pricing page).

**[45]** GitHub snyk/cli.

- Data extracted: CLI scans and monitors projects. Install via npm install -g snyk.

**[46]** Snyk Docs. "Snyk Vulnerability Database."

- URL: https://support.snyk.io/s/article/Snyk-Vs-NPM-Audit
- Data extracted: npm audit won't report vulnerabilities for non-semver versions. npm audit is CLI only vs Snyk multi-integration approach.
- Source quality: PRIMARY but vendor comparison (inherent Snyk bias).

## OSV.dev [49-55]

**[49]** GitHub google/osv.dev.
- URL: https://github.com/google/osv.dev
- Data extracted: Launched 2021. Aggregates data from 24 sources. Apache 2.0 license. Sponsored by Google.
- Source quality: PRIMARY (project repository).

**[50]** GitGuardian Blog. "Making Sense of Open-Source Vulnerability Databases."
- URL: https://blog.gitguardian.com/open-source-vulnerability-databases-comparison/
- Data extracted: OSV uses package names instead of CPEs. NVD relies on human analysis leading to incomplete data. NVD doesn't track malicious packages.
- Source quality: SECONDARY (vendor blog). Well-structured comparison.

**[51]** OSV Docs. "Introduction to OSV."
- URL: https://google.github.io/osv.dev/
- Data extracted: OSV schema provides human and machine readable format. Maps to package versions or commit hashes.
- Source quality: PRIMARY (project documentation).

**[52]** OSV Docs. "Data sources."
- URL: https://google.github.io/osv.dev/data/
- Data extracted: Maintains conversion pipeline for Alpine SecDB, NVD CVEs for OSS, Debian Security Advisories. Covers 28+ ecosystems.
- Source quality: PRIMARY (project documentation).

**[53]** OSV Docs. "API."
- URL: https://google.github.io/osv.dev/api/
- Data extracted: POST /v1/query, GET /v1/vulns/{id}, POST /v1/querybatch. No rate limits currently. 32MiB response limit on HTTP/1.1.
- Source quality: PRIMARY (project documentation).

**[54]** GitHub Issue #783. "OSV database contains 100% of vulnerabilities from NVD/CVE since 2016."

**[55]** GitHub google/osv-scanner.

**[65]** npm Docs. "Generating provenance statements."

**[66]** GitHub Blog. "Introducing npm package provenance." April 2023.

- Data extracted: During beta (April-September 2023), 3,800+ projects adopted provenance including 134 high-impact. 500M+ downloads of provenance-enabled versions.
- Source quality: PRIMARY (GitHub official blog).

**[67]** Sigstore Blog. "npm Sigstore-powered provenance goes GA."
- URL: https://blog.sigstore.dev/npm-provenance-ga/
- Data extracted: GA since October 2023. Fulcio CA short-lived certificates. Rekor transparency log.
- Source quality: PRIMARY (Sigstore project blog).

**[68]** DEV Community. "npm Security 2025: Why Provenance and Sigstore Change Everything."
- URL: https://dev.to/dataformathub/npm-security-2025-why-provenance-and-sigstore-change-everything-2m7j
- Data extracted: npm handles tens of billions of downloads/month, ~40k publishing events/day. 4.5 trillion requests in 2024. Adoption not universal.

**[69]** Chainguard. "npm + Sigstore: Making Javascript secure by default."
- URL: https://www.chainguard.dev/unchained/npm-sigstore-making-javascript-secure-by-default
- Data extracted: Keyless signing via OIDC tokens. Single-use keypair deleted after signature. Fulcio CA binds key to CI job identity.
- Source quality: SECONDARY (security vendor blog).

**[70]** Socket Blog. "npm Registry Code Signing."
- URL: https://socket.dev/blog/npm-provenance
- Data extracted: Registry verifies provenance signature, checks package name/version/tarball sha-512, verifies repo URL matches certificate.
- Source quality: SECONDARY (vendor blog).

## Python Package Signing / PEP 740 [71-74]

**[71]** PyPI Blog. "PyPI now supports digital attestations." November 2024.
- URL: https://blog.pypi.org/posts/2024-11-14-pypi-now-supports-digital-attestations/
- Data extracted: PEP 740 Final status. Identity-based signing. Verified on upload. ~20,000 packages can attest by default. PyPI publishing workflow v1.11.0+ default. PGP disabled May 2023.
- Source quality: PRIMARY (PyPI official blog).

**[72]** PEP 740. "Index support for digital attestations."
- URL: https://peps.python.org/pep-0740/
- Data extracted: Standards Track PEP. Created January 8, 2024. Final status.
- Source quality: PRIMARY (Python Enhancement Proposal).

**[73]** Trail of Bits Blog. "Attestations: A new generation of signatures on PyPI." November 2024.
- URL: https://blog.trailofbits.com/2024/11/14/attestations-a-new-generation-of-signatures-on-pypi/
- Data extracted: Three advantages over PGP: identity-based, verifiable source link, verified on upload. Downstream verification still missing. Funded by Sovereign Tech Agency and Google.
- Source quality: PRIMARY (implementer blog).

**[74]** Trail of Bits. "Are we PEP 740 yet?"
- URL: https://trailofbits.github.io/are-we-pep740-yet/
- Data extracted: Tracks 360 most-downloaded PyPI packages. At launch ~5% had attestations (20/360). ~two-thirds not updated since enablement.
- Source quality: PRIMARY (live tracker). November 2024 data, likely stale.
